pick.name: Meetily
pick.what: Local meeting recorder + Whisper transcription + optional local-LLM summaries
pick.why: Botless and fully local on Windows, so it is acceptable for bot-banning and healthcare clients (nothing leaves your machine).
pick.free_limits: Community Edition free, MIT; summaries via local Ollama or own API key. Paid Meetily PRO tier exists (better accuracy, templates, exports). Windows installer needs AVX2 x64 CPU

alts.name: Granola
alts.why: Most polished notes and templates; use for ordinary B2B calls where cloud processing is fine.
alts.free_limits: Basic $0: 30 days meeting history; Business $14/user/mo; HIPAA workspaces only on Enterprise $35/user/mo; DPA on all plans
alts.windows_fit: native (Windows availability not stated on pricing page)

alts.name: Buzz
alts.what: Local Whisper transcription of audio/video files
alts.why: Most stable local transcriber: record with Meet/OBS, then transcribe offline.

candidates.name: Google Meet recording
candidates.verdict: Google's own recorder, no third-party bot; needs Google One 2TB+ or Workspace (AI Pro eligibility unconfirmed)

candidates.name: Fathom
candidates.verdict: free unlimited but uses a bot on Windows (botless beta is Mac)

candidates.name: Otter
candidates.verdict: joins as a bot; free 300 min/mo

candidates.name: Jamie
candidates.verdict: free 10 notes/mo; Windows/bot status not stated

decision: Meetily is the only free option that is botless and keeps audio on-device, which is the safe default for healthcare and bot-averse clients. Use Granola for routine sales/discovery calls once you want better summaries; never send regulated-client recordings to a cloud tool without a BAA.
details: Always ask consent to record; Indian DPDP Act and client NDAs apply.

verify.note: MIT, Windows x64-setup.exe confirmed. v0.4.1 dated 12 Sep 2026 is marked Latest (stable), not a pre-release line. Installer uses a Vulkan Whisper build and needs an AVX2 x64 CPU (fine on a modern AMD laptop). A separate paid 'Meetily PRO' exists; the Community Edition stays free. 32.3k stars.
